title: 1999 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: The third exit on a highway is located at milepost \(40\) and the tenth exit is at milepost \(160.\) There is a service center on the highway located three-fourths of the way from the third exit to the tenth exit. At what milepost would you expect to find this service center?

solutions.text:
There are \(160 - 40 = 120\) miles between the third and tenth exits.

This means \(\frac{3}{4}\) of the way is at the \[ 40 + \dfrac{3}{4} \cdot 120 = 130 \] milepost.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: First find the distance between mileposts \(40\) and \(160\)
Move \(\frac{3}{4}\) of that distance past milepost \(40\)
